What we move and haul

  • Local moves

    →

    Crew, truck and pads billed by the hour, with the estimate checked against the clock at midday.

  • Junk by the load

    →

    You pay for the share of the truck your pile fills, measured in eighths before we load.

  • One item

    →

    One couch, mattress, hot tub cover or treadmill carried out and taken away.

  • Labor only

    →

    Two or three people load your rental truck or container, heaviest pieces to the front.

  • Packing

    →

    Boxes, paper and tape brought to you, and a packer for the kitchen if you want one.

  • Lease-end moves

    →

    Short apartment moves near campus during the August lease change, booked in two-hour blocks.

  • Cleanouts

    →

    We sort donation, metal and trash in the driveway so less of it goes to the landfill.

  • Appliances

    →

    Old fridges, freezers and washers carried out, with refrigerant handled by the recycler.

  • Storage

    →

    Your load stays wrapped on our truck or in a locked unit for a few days between closings.

Common questions

How early should I book?

Two to three weeks for local moves in peak season (June–August). Junk pickups can often be scheduled within a few days.

Do I need to empty drawers?

Light clothing can stay. Remove heavy items, books and anything that could shift or damage the drawer during transit.

What if my move takes longer than estimated?

If the job runs past the high end of your written estimate, the extra time is on us.

Can you disassemble furniture?

Yes. Beds, tables and shelving units are taken apart and reassembled at the destination as part of the hourly rate.
